!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Single-cell sequencing was performed using the Chromium Single-Cell v2 3’ and 5’ Chemistry Library, Gel Bead, Multiplex and Chip Kits (10X Genomics) according to the manufacturer's protocol. A total of 5,000 to 7,000 cells were targeted per well.
Libraries were sequenced on the NextSeq 500 platform (Illumina) with pair-ended sequencing and dual indexing. A total of 26, 8 and 98 cycles were run for Read 1, i7 index and Read 2, respectively.
!Sample_description: ***Raw Data Disclaimer: Raw human data files are deposited to the EGA (EGAS00001005173) to adhere to ethics.***
!Sample_data_processing: Raw bcl files were demultiplexed and mapped to the reference genome GRCh38 using the Cell Ranger Single Cell v2.0 software (10X Genomics). The EmptyDrops method from the DropletUtils package (v1.2.2) was applied for cell filtering with additional cutoffs for cells with a gene and unique molecular identifier (UMIs) count greater than 200 and 250, respectively, and a mitochondrial percentage less than 20%.
Genome_build: GRCh38
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Processed data files in MM matrix format (*.mtx), genes and barcode IDs (*.tsv)
